sections.title: What's New
items: Get a notice when an update is ready, with Remind me later and View update buttons.
Choose an analog clock face for the lock screen under Customization in Home.
Press and hold an app on the taskbar to open it in split screen, and swap the two apps with Change order.
Choose the day your week starts on for the calendar in mission control.
Switch apps with a sideways swipe along the bottom edge after turning on app-switch swipes under Experimental in Home; several fast swipes in a row keep switching.
Hold an app in the sidebar to see its quick actions.
Turn split screen on or off under Customization in Home.
Uninstall Niagara, Markup, Exchange and Reader if you don't use them; a factory reset brings them back.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Confirm before Software Update installs an update you started and restarts your tablet.
See a short message while an update installs and restarts your tablet, and a note with the new version afterwards.
Press the power button once to put your tablet to sleep right away.
Double-press the power button while your tablet is asleep to open Kindle straight away, over the lock screen.
Drag the Quick Settings sliders to change them; a tap no longer makes them jump.
See the lock screen in two columns, clock and notifications side by side, when your tablet is on its side.
See a thinner split-screen divider that follows dark mode.
See app icons keep their solid shapes in dark mode, and the Logos app its own icon.
Scroll the A to Z app list and return to Home more smoothly.
See during setup when a Wi-Fi network needs a sign-in or has no internet.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed a USB message that kept coming back, and file transfer stopping, while Daylight Link runs on a connected computer.
Fixed Settings feeling slow; its pages open full screen again.
Fixed Release Notes not opening from Software Update.
Fixed Google Meet getting stuck on a loading screen during its first-time setup.
Fixed “Unlock for all features” appearing on the lock screen after a restart.
Fixed the lock screen picture flashing after you enter your PIN; the screen now fades into Home.
Fixed the tutorial's app picker not showing all of your apps.
Fixed a resting palm on the bottom edge opening the taskbar or switching apps while you write.
Fixed apps shifting when you swipe up from the bottom edge; the pen still writes there and taps still reach the app.
Fixed the Auto theme staying dark after sunrise when you wake your tablet.
Fixed the orange button opening Note Overlay over the lock screen when pressed while your tablet is asleep or locked.
Fixed split screen breaking when an app opens over the lock screen, such as Kindle from the power button; the pair comes back when you unlock.

sections.title: What's New
items: Set a button shortcut to open the AI overlay.

sections.title: Improvements
items: See a redesigned Settings app in the SolOS style.

sections.title: Important
items: Daylight View is not included in this release.

sections.title: What's New
items: Set a button shortcut to switch back to your previous app.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Read the release notes in a window inside Software Update, with your installed version marked, instead of on a web page.
Turn the light back on with a button shortcut and it returns to its last brightness.
Tap the icons at either end of the Quick Settings sliders to adjust them.
See the last stretch of the Amber slider marked with a notch, and hear a distinct sound at full Amber and at the lowest light.
Follow the tutorial's taskbar lesson more easily, with only the lesson's app on the taskbar and your Home screen behind it.

sections.title: Improvements
items: See refreshed welcome and setup-complete screens, with smoother animations, illustrated scenery and larger rounded buttons.

sections.title: Important
items: After this update, your tablet returns to the Home space once; your previous spaces are backed up.
Magic Ink is temporarily turned off in this release.

sections.title: What's New
items: Open Quick Settings directly from the lock screen.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Learn more from expanded tutorials covering the Home screen, taskbar and hardware buttons.
See your app shortcuts as soon as the taskbar opens.
Swipe in from the left edge to go back, leaving the right edge free for gestures inside apps.
Get clearer guidance for the Amber slider and taskbar gestures.
See refreshed Home screen visuals and smoother animations.

sections.title: Important
items: This update removes the previous Note Overlay app and deletes the notes stored in it; its daily backups stay in Download/Note Overlay 3/Backups.
Updates marked for automatic installation may now install and restart your tablet during the day, not only overnight.

sections.title: What's New
items: Alpha tablets can now check for and install selected updates automatically.

sections.title: Improvements
items: See a refreshed design in Software Update.
Use the updated Daylight View, with its accessibility support turned on automatically after updating.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed two note overlays running at once; only the new Note Overlay app is now included.
Fixed a Play Protect “App scan recommended” prompt appearing when the Daylight Store installs or updates Daylight's own apps; other apps are still checked as usual.

sections.title: What's New
items: Discover SolOS features with a new guided tutorial.
View notifications and music controls on the updated lock screen.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Swipe inward from either screen edge to go back.
Take screenshots without a screen flash or shutter sound.
Enjoy a smoother taskbar and more reliable app switching.
See clearer Wi-Fi information and improved controls in Quick Settings.
Close the Note Overlay pad with a second upward swipe.
Automatic dark mode follows your local sunrise and sunset more accurately.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed cases where quick button presses could trigger the wrong action.
Fixed issues with taskbar taps and closing apps.
Removed unnecessary kids' app installers from the system image; apps already installed remain available.

sections.title: Important
items: Notes stored in the previous Note Overlay app are not automatically imported into the new app in this release.

sections.title: What's New
items: Use the redesigned Note Overlay with the orange action button.
Customize supported hardware-button shortcuts in Settings.
Explore the redesigned lock screen.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Enjoy a refreshed Quick Settings panel, including a better landscape layout and larger sliders.
See connected Wi-Fi and Bluetooth device names more clearly.
Use a smoother taskbar and more reliable swipe gestures after rotating the screen.
Adjust screen warmth and frontlight brightness with refined controls.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Kindle can now update to the newer included version without losing its app data.
Fixed issues that could leave parts of Quick Settings faded or cause problems when Bluetooth device information was unavailable.

sections.title: What's New
items: Get a connection notification when the Daylight keyboard case connects, including its battery level when available.
Check supported Bluetooth accessory battery levels in Settings.
Explore improved app switching and Mission Control.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Adjust frontlight brightness more precisely with updated controls.
Use expanded hardware-button actions and shortcuts.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Improved Bluetooth reliability for supported accessories.
Prepared Note Overlay for future app updates through the Daylight Store.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Updated the SolOS Home experience.
Improved the way the tablet returns to Home when app switching is interrupted.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed a crash that could occur if you returned Home before an app finished opening.
Fixed cases where app switching could leave a blank screen.

sections.title: What's New
items: Try the updated SolOS Home and Quick Settings experience.
Use the redesigned compact taskbar for app navigation.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Quick Settings stays accessible after initial setup.
Simplified Home navigation and streamlined the taskbar.
Updated the Home and HUD apps.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed a critical startup issue affecting the previous alpha release.
Updated SolOS Home and Store compatibility.

sections.title: What's New
items: Meet the refreshed SolOS Quick Settings and compact app-navigation experience.
Enjoy smoother screen transitions.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Pen strokes no longer pull down Quick Settings while writing near the top of the screen.
Holding the orange button from sleep more reliably starts a snip.
Updated the included Kindle app for new installations.
Improved support for passkey sign-in.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Improved passkey sign-in using another device, including supported QR-code flows.
Updated the Daylight Store integration for app updates.

sections.title: What's New
items: Added Daylight Store and Daylight Experiments to the system image.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed a welcome/setup card that could reappear after restarting the tablet.
Corrected the software version shown in Settings.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Improved the transition to SolOS Home after upgrading from older software.
Added Niagara Launcher as an optional launcher choice.
Updated Note Overlay with a fix for notes getting stuck while saving after moving a snip.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Improved orange-button and walkie-talkie behavior when waking the tablet.
Made the updated Alpha 10 fixes available through a distinct software update version.

sections.title: What's New
items: Added an optional Stylus boost setting for more responsive pen interaction on supported display modes.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Improved performance support for apps that request faster processing during active work.
Improved the reliability of SolOS Home after updating from older launcher versions.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed unwanted taskbar and screen flashes that could appear after startup.
Fixed several screenshot/snipping interface issues.
Fixed an issue that could leave a dark bar along the bottom of the screen.
Improved the reliability of the orange action button and walkie-talkie shortcuts.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Double-press the orange button to open the note pad more reliably, including when waking the tablet.
Improved the appearance of the Home screen after restarting or updating.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed the black bar and brief app-switching flashes that could appear during startup.
Removed an unnecessary Daylight Keys notification at startup.
Fixed clipping in the snip labeling controls.
Improved the consistency of display-setting resets immediately after an update.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed an issue where the display size could reset after every restart instead of only after a software update.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Writing with the stylus near the edge of the screen is less likely to trigger navigation gestures accidentally.
Improved rejection of accidental touches from your resting palm while writing.
Improved double-press recognition for the power button.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Removed a dark strip from the bottom of the first-time setup experience.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Press the orange button to wake the screen and open the note pad.
Updated Note Overlay and the Magic Ink experience.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed an issue where pressing the orange button while the tablet was asleep did not wake the screen.

sections.title: What's New
items: Added Daylight account sign-in support during setup.
Improved Magic Ink and AI overlay functionality.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Camera and microphone permissions are ready for supported video-calling apps installed from Google Play, while remaining adjustable in Settings.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed voice labeling for screenshots and snips so it works without additional permission setup.
Removed an unwanted dark strip at the bottom of the Home screen.

sections.title: What's New
items: Hold the orange button to take a snip.
Use Magic Ink and the walkie-talkie AI overlay with supported hardware buttons.
Hold a volume button to change screen brightness.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Updated the Daylight View app.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Improved Zoom compatibility with supported external USB webcams.

sections.title: Improvements
items: The orange button opens the note pad without additional setup.
Note Overlay can appear over other apps as intended.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed an issue where accessibility services could become disabled after restarting.

sections.title: What's New
items: Introduced Note Overlay as part of SolOS.
Added initial support for orange-button note shortcuts.
Added a power-button double-press shortcut for Kindle.
